test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e. **'Techniques'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the context** of the sentence, the word** "techniques"** refers to specific methods or approaches used to achieve a particular result, in this case, making a child want to learn.
 
• As a parent, you are likely always looking for effective techniques that can spark your child's interest and motivation to learn.
 
• **The sentence suggests** that reading strategies are one such set of techniques designed to engage children and foster their enthusiasm for reading.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Children learn to walk and talk naturally, (1) but that is not the case with reading. Reading strategies are designed to help your child develop a strong reading (2) foundation one built with confidence engagement and joy. As a parent, you are most likely always looking for (3) techniques that make your child want to learn. We are here to help you and your child on their journey as a (4) ________ reader. Try some reading strategy suggestions below for kids (5) _______ are beginning to read all the way to those reading advanced chapter books. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blueprints:** This option does not fit well in the sentence. Blueprints are detailed plans or designs used in construction or engineering, and they do not convey the idea of methods or approaches to make a child want to learn.
 
• **Fashions: **This option does not fit well in the sentence. Fashions refer to popular trends or styles, and it does not convey the idea of specific techniques or methods to promote learning.
 
• **Lines: **This option does not fit well in the sentence. "Lines" usually refers to a series of words or phrases, and it does not convey the idea of techniques or methods for enhancing a child's desire to learn.
